"""Push a tiny private GPU smoke kernel to Kaggle and fetch its output.

Runs inside the Colab bridge worker. Credentials arrive via environment only in
memory (KAGGLE_API_TOKEN or KAGGLE_USERNAME+KAGGLE_KEY); never printed/exported.
Creates ONE private kernel. No datasets, no competitions, no public resources.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path

print("COLAB_EXECUTE_OK", flush=True)
ART = Path(os.environ["BRIDGE_ARTIFACT_DIR"]); ART.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
LOGS = []
def log(msg):
    LOGS.append(str(msg)); print(msg, flush=True)
def sh(args, timeout=120):
    return subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)

report = {"job": "kaggle-t4-smoke-20261112-01",
          "start": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())}

token = os.environ.get("KAGGLE_API_TOKEN", "").strip()
user = os.environ.get("KAGGLE_USERNAME", "").strip()
key = os.environ.get("KAGGLE_KEY", "").strip()
if token:
    kd = Path.home() / ".kaggle"; kd.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    p = kd / "access_token"; p.write_text(token + "\n"); p.chmod(0o600)
    report["cred"] = "token"
elif user and key:
    report["cred"] = "legacy-pair"
else:
    report["status"] = "skipped"; report["reason"] = "KAGGLE_SECRET_MISSING"
    (ART / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
    raise SystemExit(0)

uname = ""
try:
    from kaggle.api.kaggle_api_extended import KaggleApi
    api = KaggleApi(); api.authenticate()
    uname = (api.config_values.get("username") or "").strip()
except Exception as exc:
    log(f"username via api failed: {type(exc).__name__}")
if not uname:
    r = sh([sys.executable, "-m", "kaggle", "kernels", "list", "--mine", "--csv", "--page-size", "1"], 90)
    for line in (r.stdout or "").splitlines()[1:]:
        if "/" in line:
            uname = line.split(",")[0].split("/")[0].strip(); break
if not uname:
    report["status"] = "failed"; report["reason"] = "cannot resolve kaggle username"
    (ART / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
    raise SystemExit(1)
report["kaggle_user"] = uname

slug = "arena-t4-smoke-20261112"
stage = Path("/tmp/arena_kernel"); stage.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(stage / "main.py").write_text('import json, subprocess, time\nimport torch\nout = {"ts": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),\n       "torch": torch.__version__, "cuda": torch.cuda.is_available(),\n       "devices": [torch.cuda.get_device_name(i) for i in range(torch.cuda.device_count())]}\nif out["cuda"]:\n    x = torch.randn(2048, 2048, device="cuda")\n    out["matmul_mean"] = float((x @ x).mean().item())\nsmi = subprocess.run(["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=index,name,memory.total",\n                      "--format=csv,noheader"], capture_output=True, text=True)\nout["nvidia_smi"] = smi.stdout.strip()\nwith open("/kaggle/working/smoke_result.json", "w") as f:\n    json.dump(out, f, indent=2)\nprint(json.dumps(out))\n')
meta = {"id": f"{uname}/{slug}", "title": "arena t4 smoke 20261112",
        "code_file": "main.py", "language": "python", "kernel_type": "script",
        "is_private": "true", "enable_gpu": "true", "enable_internet": "true"}
(stage / "kernel-metadata.json").write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=2))

r = sh([sys.executable, "-m", "kaggle", "kernels", "push", "-p", str(stage)], 120)
report["push_exit"] = r.returncode
if r.returncode != 0:
    report["status"] = "failed"; report["push_err"] = ((r.stderr or r.stdout or "")[-500:])
    (ART / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
    raise SystemExit(1)
ref = f"{uname}/{slug}"
log(f"pushed {ref}")

deadline = time.time() + 1700
final = "timeout"
while time.time() < deadline:
    time.sleep(30)
    r = sh([sys.executable, "-m", "kaggle", "kernels", "status", ref], 60)
    txt = ((r.stdout or "") + (r.stderr or "")).lower()
    log("status: " + txt.strip()[:120])
    if "complete" in txt:
        final = "completed"; break
    if "error" in txt or "cancel" in txt:
        final = "failed"; break
report["kernel_status"] = final

out = Path("/tmp/arena_kout")
r = sh([sys.executable, "-m", "kaggle", "kernels", "output", ref, "-p", str(out), "-o"], 300)
report["output_exit"] = r.returncode
copied = []
for f in sorted(out.rglob("*")):
    if f.is_file() and f.stat().st_size <= 2 * 1024 * 1024:
        (ART / f.name).write_bytes(f.read_bytes()); copied.append(f.name)
report["copied"] = copied
report["kernel_url"] = f"https://www.kaggle.com/code/{ref}"
report["status"] = final
report["end"] = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())
(ART / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
(ART / "job.log").write_text("\n".join(LOGS))
